# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# scenario: --scenario voting.
# NOT IN DESIGN.md §8's deliverable list; added by Phase 0 with its reason recorded in
# decisions/phase0-mock.md and tests/fixtures/README.md ("Additions"). The reason: DESIGN.md §1b.3
# and §5c devote a paragraph each to the fact that `version` and the six voting fields of ONE
# hard_fork_info response describe TWO DIFFERENT fork versions, and §5c requires `node info` to
# publish them apart, under hard_fork.current_version and hard_fork.voting_on.version. On mainnet
# TODAY they coincide (both 16, because the fork table ends at v16 -- hardforks.cpp:75), so against
# hard_fork_info.json a consumer that conflated them would pass every test. This fixture is the only
# way to make that assertion non-vacuous before a real v17 fork ships.
# fields: identical to hard_fork_info.json -- COMMAND_RPC_HARD_FORK_INFO::response_t,
#         src/rpc/core_rpc_server_commands_defs.h:1974-1994. Only the values differ.
# SHAPE: a hypothetical v17 being voted on while v16 is still current, i.e. what
#         on_hard_fork_info (src/rpc/core_rpc_server.cpp:2738-2741) returns for req.version == 0
#         once a v17 row exists in the table:
#           version         = get_current_hard_fork_version() = 16   <- the CURRENT fork
#           voting          = heights.back().version           = 17  <- the NEXT one
#           enabled         = current_version >= 17            = false
#           votes           = blocks in the window voting >= 17      (7412 of 10080 so far)
#           threshold       = (10080 * threshold_pct + 99) / 100; a future row need not carry 0,
#                             so this fixture uses the 80% default (hardfork.h:52) -> 8064
#           earliest_height = the v17 row's height
#           state           = HardFork::State::UpdateNeeded = 1 (hardfork.h:42-46) -- what a v0.18
#                             daemon reports when a newer fork is scheduled and it is not ready
# The heights and the version number here are INVENTED: there is no v17 in v0.18.5.1. That is the
# point of the file and it is why it is a scenario rather than the default.
